marta: noticed spike in Pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1-A, a lot of tiny jobs blocked while several warm nodes at ~15% CPU/GPU
devin: show me the packing heatmap?

sam: any taint/label changes overnight?
marta: ops ran a rolling drain on rack-12; nodes got `rack-maint=true:NoSchedule` then readded but some came back with label `gpu.family=ga100` vs `gpu-family=ga100` mismatch
ops-bot: scheduler-alert: 22 pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1-A >10m; likely label mismatch + tiny-pod fragmentation. Recommended: compact small pods, temporary reserve bump, reconcile labels
devin: short-term: run compacter to binpack low-req pods onto warm nodes, bump reserve by +8 GPUs for 10m
lee: i'll patch node-label-reconciler to map common variants (dot vs dash vs underscore) and add unit test
marta: kicked compaction job and reserve bump, pending dropped 22 -> 4 in 4m :thumbsup: — will monitor for 30m
sam: file a follow-up ticket to adjust warm-pool sizing thresholds and add cohort-scatter alert
ops-bot: incident cleared: pending <5 for 10m; monitoring for 60m
